construct: The common severe Z variant of SERPINA1 causes abnormal alpha-1 antitrypsin folding and polymerization within hepatocytes, impairing secretion. Liver disease is a toxic gain-of-function process from intracellular protein retention, whereas emphysema results from loss of circulating antiprotease activity.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Low serum AAT plus panacinar emphysema and PAS-positive diastase-resistant hepatocyte globules indicates AAT deficiency; liver injury results from retained polymerized mutant AAT.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Unopposed neutrophil elastase is central to the lung disease and could be tempting, but it does not explain the hepatocyte inclusions or hepatic toxicity.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Because the lead asks specifically about hepatic injury, intracellular polymer retention is uniquely correct.
